name: MAYBANK
recent: Maybank 在2026年11月发布最新季度业绩，同时大股东 Amanahraya Trustees（Amanah Saham Bumiputera）、EPF、PNB、KWAP 等申报股权变动。9月公司完成 RM2.5 billion AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行，并发行 US$700 million 双批次美元债券。
notable: 完成 RM2.5 billion AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行。
通过双批次美元债券筹集 US$700 million。
发布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。
risks: Amanahraya Trustees（Amanah Saham Bumiputera）在11月多次申报股权变动。
EPF、PNB、KWAP 及 Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra 在11月申报股权变动。
董事局出现变动，Datuk Izham bin Ismail 的董事局职务有变更。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为 MYR 7,147.2 million，环比增长2.2%，同比减少0.9%；净利为 MYR 2,690.4 million，环比增长8.5%，同比增长2.4%；净利率为37.6%，高于上一季度的35.5%。

recent_en: Maybank released its latest quarterly results in November 2026, while major shareholders including Amanahraya Trustees (Amanah Saham Bumiputera), EPF, PNB and KWAP filed changes in shareholdings. In September the company completed a RM2.5 billion AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance and a US$700 million dual-tranche dollar bond sale.
notable_en: Completed a RM2.5 billion AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance.
Raised US$700 million via a dual-tranche dollar bond sale.
Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Amanahraya Trustees (Amanah Saham Bumiputera) filed multiple changes in shareholdings in November.
EPF, PNB, KWAP and Yayasan Pelaburan Bumiputra filed changes in shareholdings in November.
There was a change in the boardroom involving Datuk Izham bin Ismail.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7,147.2 million, up 2.2% QoQ but down 0.9% YoY; net income was MYR 2,690.4 million, up 8.5% QoQ and 2.4% YoY; net margin was 37.6%, higher than 35.5% in the previous quarter.
